notes: SA leadership ends before the later world war. Second-revolution anti-capitalism is not a precise complete Marxist economic programme. SA autonomous command does not establish public decentralisation. His same-sex relationships do not establish equal marriage or a general LGBT-rights position; SA repression remains counter-evidence. Religion remains undisclosed. Reviewed all 240 literal statements and directions, all 15 independent axis briefs, contradictory evidence, sources, period, metadata and educated assumptions. Corrected readings of cultural plurality, unconditional refugee settlement and Catholic embryo-enhancement analogies where applicable. All 240 responses remain conservatively inferred, with exact IDs in the separate review. Neutral responses express qualified or competing positions, not a default for uncertainty. Technical checks do not certify historical or political estimates. Neutral-density diagnostics reviewed against each literal mechanism, private/public or institutional trade-off, and counter-evidence; exact warnings and neutral rationales are retained in the separate review.
